text: Completed research assistance on the FertiMeter project, which was published in IEEE Access as an early-access article.
Research on climatic influences and urinary tract infections was accepted for presentation at the 17th International Conference on Engineering & Natural Sciences in Prague.
Presented research at the BIE Seminar 2025 on Climate Resilience and Sustainable Development and received the Best Presenter Award.
The project on community attitudes toward lower-extremity joint replacement was accepted for the AMA Research Challenge 2025.
Began serving as Program Head at Positive Plus Foundation.
